items.title: Your Love
items.description: An application designed to improve communication and strengthen relationships between partners, especially for those in long-distance relationships or lacking quality time together. The project solves the problem of misunderstandings by creating a private digital space for the couple.
features: Interactivity: mood tracking, partner well-being, and a shared "Wish list".
Real-time: WebSockets for seamless real-time synchronization.
Security: login via Google and Discord OAuth.

items.title: Movie Ticket Booking Platform
items.description: A modern alternative to outdated cinema platforms with illogical UX. The main goal: to make the user journey from searching for a movie to getting a ticket as fast, pleasant, and intuitive as possible.
features: Thoughtful UX/UI: dynamic routing and instant navigation without reloading.
Reliability: client and server form validation.
High-performance architecture: C# microservices, RabbitMQ, and Redis for handling high loads.

items.title: Game HUB
items.description: Game HUB is a social platform for gamers designed to make cooperative gameplay even more dynamic and fun. The project solves the problem of time synchronization between players and adds a fun element of gamification to regular gaming sessions.
features: Schedule synchronization: Interactive calendar to view other players' availability.
Lobby gamification: Issuing unique rewards after a game ("Best Sniper", "MVP", "Joker").
Discord ecosystem: Discord authorization. Future bot integration for automatic session creation and reminders.
